text: I loved building sandcastles with my grandpa, until my mom took the urn away.
I’ll never forget my grandpa's last words before he kicked the bucket: “hey, how far do you think I can kick this bucket?”
Just before my grandpa passed, he said pull my finger.
My grandfather died peacefully in his sleep. Not like the screaming passengers in his car.
Algebra for the Romans must have been super easy. X was always ten.
Someone asked me why I liked Worcestershire sauce. I replied, it’s hard to say.

My wife kicked me out of the house. On my way out she yelled, “I hope you spend the rest of your life in pain and misery.” I replied, “Make up your mind. First you want me to leave. Now you want me to stay?”
I caught my 7 year-old son chewing on electrical wiring. I had to ground him. He’s conducting himself better now.
A policeman came to my door and said, “I’m looking for a suspicious person with one eye.” I replied, “Your search might go more easily if you use both eyes.”
A fisherman and a mermaid just got married. They met online.
I’m not wearing glasses anymore. I’ve seen enough.
A history degree is useless. There’s no future in it.
What did the apple say to the kangaroo? Nothing. Apples don’t talk.
My son was accused of theft and got fired from his road worker job. I just couldn't believe it. but, when I went into his room, all the signs were there.
Cross-eyed teacher cannot control pupils
Man who live in glass house should shower in basement.
I told my wife to embrace her mistakes. She hugged me.
Why didn’t the worms go on Noah’s Ark in an apple? Because they were supposed to go in pairs.
Did you hear about the two thieves that stole the calendar? They each got 6 months.
So long boiling water. You will be missed.
Do you know why the Swedish navy ships have bar codes on them? So they can scan the navy in.
I was wondering why the frisbee kept getting bigger and bigger. And then it hit me.
How do you catch a unique bird? Unique up on it.
I was hired to be a bullet. I was immediately fired.
When someone tells me to stop acting like a flamingo, that’s when I put my foot down.

Person 1: May I interrupt to say a quick word?
Person 2: Sure, go ahead.
Person 1: Plethora
Person 2: Thank you. That means a lot.
To the person that stole my Microsoft Office license. I will find you. You have my Word.
My friend said, “I don’t understand cloning.” I responded with, “That makes two of us.”
I was going to tell you a time traveling joke, but you didn’t like it.
My roommate thinks I’m schizophrenic, but the jokes on him. I don’t have a roommate.
Why does the Little Mermaid wear Seashells? Because B-shells are too small.
What kind of bees make milk instead of honey? Boo Bees.

I used to be addicted to the hokey-pokey.
But I turned myself around…
And that’s what it’s all about.

I’m addicted to airport jokes. But, don’t worry. My doctor says it’s not terminal.
The problem is, all my jokes are plane.
I’m the fabric version of King Midas. Everything I touch becomes felt.
What do you call a lazy baby kangaroo? A pouch potato.
The calendar had better watch its back. Its days are numbered.
Lately, people have been making apocalypse jokes like there’s no tomorrow.
I once swallowed a book of synonyms. It gave me thesaurus throat I’ve ever had.

Q: What do Winne the Pooh, Alexander the Great, and Ivan the Terrible have in common?
A: They all have the same middle name.
Why did the elephants get kicked off the surfing team? They just couldn’t keep their trunks up.
Why did the giraffe break up with her boyfriend? He was a cheetah.
What do you call a cow with one leg? Stake
What do you get when you cross a Dad joke with a rhetorical question?

I heard on the news that someone had robbed the Tokyo Origami Museum in Japan.
The anchor said that the story was still unfolding.
Of all the inventions in human history, the dry erase board has to be the most remarkable.
Those who fail History are doomed to repeat it.
I used to be addicted to not showering, but I eventually got clean.
I heard Humpty Dumpty is having an awful winter, which is a shame, because he had a great fall!
I told my mom that she had drawn her eyebrows too high. She looked surprised!
I used to have a job digging tunnels underground. It was really boring.
What did the notebook say when it graduated? College ruled.
I tried to date a tennis player once, but love meant nothing to her.
As I handed my dad his fiftieth birthday card, he looked at me with tears in his eyes and said, “You know, one would have been enough.”
To the person on crutches who stole my camouflage jacket: you can hide, but you can’t run.
Parallel lines have so much in common. It’s a shame they’ll never meet.
Why did the picture go to jail? It was framed!
I used to work at a calendar factory, but I got fired after I took a couple of days off.
Why did the old lady fall down the well? She didn’t see that well.
My old job involved crushing cans. I had to quit because it was soda-pressing.
I got a job taking care of horses. It provides a stable income.
A company is introducing glass coffins. Will they be successful? Remains to be seen.
My ex-girlfriend was obsessed with trying to find the largest known prime number. I wonder what she’s up to now.
I used to be addicted to Thanksgiving leftovers. I had to quit cold turkey.
Did you know that every planet in the solar system was named after a god. Except Earth… which was named after all that stuff on the ground.

Flight Attendant to Passenger: Do you want dinner?
Passenger: What are my options?
Flight Attendant: Yes or no.

Thanksgiving Shopper looking at a bunch of small, frozen turkeys. She says to the Stock Boy: Do these turkeys get any bigger?
Stock Boy: No, ma’am. They’re dead.

Policeman to Speeder when giving a ticket: I’ve been waiting for you all day.
Driver: Well, I got here as fast as I could.
My dog ate my computer science project.  It took him a couple bytes
I used to think orthotics could not improve my posture. I stand corrected.
Why don’t they let football players wear glasses? It’s a contact sport.
I don’t believe in atoms. They make up everything!
What did the hat say to the scarf? You hang around. I’ll go on ahead.
I read about a cartoonist who went missing. Details are sketchy at this time.
Did you know that bees are allergic to pollen? They develop hives.
My brother just called to tell me that he got sick after drinking a potion of invisibility. He’s been in the ER for 8 hours and is still waiting to be seen.
6 of 7 Dwarves are not Happy.
I hate it when people expect emotional confirmation. Am I right?!
Did you hear that Hawaii outlawed loud laughing? They only allow a low ha.
It took me 5 minutes to walk to the bar, but 20 minutes to walk back. The difference is staggering.
Last night, a man got hit by a violin, a clarinet, and then a french horn. Police say it was an orchestrated attack.
A friend of mine was abducted by a group of mimes. They did unspeakable things to him.
Why do programmers prefer to code in the dark? Because the light attracts bugs.
Did I tell you that I wrote a book on reverse psychology? Please don’t buy it.
I broke up with my mathematician girlfriend. She was obsessed with an x.
What do a swimmer and an over-worked new programmer have in common? They both have to sink or swim.
Did you know that you can go sky diving without a parachute? You just can’t go twice.
My grandfather had the heart of a lion and a lifetime ban from the zoo.
How much does Santa pay to park his sleigh? Nothing. It’s on the house.
How do celebrities stay cool?  They have many fans.
When does a joke become a Dad joke? When it becomes apparent.
Why was the guillotine a great invention? Because it was ahead of its time.
2 windmills are having a conversation. One of them asks: “What kind of music do you listen to?” The other responds with: “Well, I’m a huge metal fan.”
Last night I dreamt I weighed less than 1/1000 of a gram. I was like 0mg.
What are two things you can never eat for breakfast? Lunch and Dinner.
What do sprinters eat before a race? nothing, they fast!
What kind of beverage is bitter and sweet? Reali-tea
What happens when you shake milk? It becomes a milkshake.
What do you call an alligator in a vest? An investigator.
Did you hear the rumor about butter? Ok then well, I'm not gonna spread it.
What do Santa's elves listen to as they work? Wrap music.
What do you call a cow with no legs? Ground beef.
What did the doctor say to the skeleton? You’re too late.
Why do eggs never tell jokes? They would crack each other up!
When I was little my mom told me I could be anyone I wanted. Turns out identity theft is illegal.
Did you hear about the cheese that saved the world? It was legend dairy.

Why did the math homework look sad?
Because it had too many problems.

Did you hear about the mathematician who had a problem with constipation?
He worked it out with a pencil.
What rock group has four men that don’t sing? Mount Rushmore!
What concert costs just 45 cents? 50 Cent featuring Nickelback!
Why couldn't the bicycle stand up by itself? It was two-tired.
I want to go on a diet, but I really feel like I have way too much on my plate.
What do you call a fake pasta? An Impasta!

What did one Japanese person say to the other Japanese person?
I don't know, I don't speak Japanese.
Why don’t crabs give to charity? Because they’re shellfish.
Why did the cyborg have to rest after his long road trip? Because he had a hard drive.

What is green and fuzzy and if it fell out of a tree it would kill you?
A pool table.
What is a snake’s favorite subject? Computer ssssscience!
What were the balloon’s last words to his dad? Watch me pop.
Where do dad's keep there jokes? In a Dad-a-base.

Past, Present, and Future walked into a bar.
It was tense.
What do you call a fish with no eyes? fshhhhhhhhhh
Why was 4 afraid to ask out 5? Because she was 2 squared!
What does a vampire teacher eat? Stew-dent.
Man run in front of car, Man get tired. Man run in back of car, Man get exhausted.
Culinary school is easy. The final exam was a piece of cake!
How many ears does Captain Kirk have? 3... left ear, right ear, and the final frontier.
Why does Waldo wear striped shirts. He doesn’t want to be spotted.
What animal can jump higher than a house. All of them. Houses can’t jump.
I’ll never date an apostrophe again. The last one was too possessive.
Which animal has even more lives than a cat?  A frog. It croaks every night.

Dad, what do you want for your birthday this year?
Well, just for the record, I need a new turntable.
What do you call a chicken that’s afraid of the dark? A chicken.
A man walks into a library and asks the librarian for books about paranoia. She says, “they’re right behind you”
I read the sign, “duck, eggs” and thought, ‘well, that comma is unnecessary’. And then it hit me.
To the person who stole my depression medication, I hope you’re happy.
My girlfriend broke up with me so I stole her wheelchair. Guess who came crawling back.
What did Yoda say to himself after reaching 4K resolution? (In Yoda voice: HDMI)
Gucci has a new line of clothes for babies. It’s called Gucci Goo.
What do you call a funny bone after it’s been boiled? A laughing stock.
Poop jokes aren’t my favorite. But they’re a solid number two.
How many teenagers does it take to screw in a light bulb? One. The teenager holds the light bulb and the world revolves around him.
Did you know that humans eat more bananas than monkeys? Don’t believe me? When was the last time you saw a human eat a monkey?
What’s the scariest plant in the forest?  Bam-BOO!
Did you hear they’re making a remake of the Wizard of Oz, but from the dog’s perspective?  It’s going to be called Toto Recall.
I’ve got to be at a funeral tomorrow at 9:00 am.  I hate that!  I am not a mourning person.
Why did the chicken go to the gym?  To work on its pecs.
Who was the builder of King Arthur’s round table?  Cir-cumference.
My 4 year old son can’t say please in Spanish.  That’s poor for four.
My bank keeps calling to compliment me.  They say I have an outstanding balance.
How do 37 mathematicians board a bus with only 36 seats?  They carry the one.
I tried to sue the airline for misplacing my luggage.  I lost the case.
What do you call a cow with two legs? Lean Beef
What do you call a cow with three legs? Tri-Tip
